# Phase Three — Final Critique and Thirty Further Improvements

Tiferes must reconcile speed with depth: a surface that is merely ornate is not advanced, and a surface that is merely sparse is not clear. Awtsmoos.com should feel calm until the user asks it to unfold.

1. Prefer local cascade layers inside each route to specificity escalation.
2. Avoid `!important` except proven accessibility or third-party override boundaries.
3. Give every route a documented maximum readable measure for prose.
4. Give workbench routes a documented maximum viewport density instead of prose measures.
5. Use container queries only where the component truly needs parent-aware behavior.
6. Keep CSS custom properties inside route roots so themes cannot leak.
7. Use `color-scheme` only on the owning root when feasible.
8. Add `overscroll-behavior` only to intentional scroll containers.
9. Prevent nested scroll traps on mobile.
10. Make sticky toolbars collapse before they consume meaningful content height.
11. Reserve bottom space for mobile docks so content is never hidden beneath them.
12. Avoid translucent layers above text when contrast cannot be guaranteed.
13. Expose selected/current state independently of color.
14. Make destructive actions spatially and visually distinct from primary actions.
15. Require a confirmation boundary only where reversal is costly; do not burden harmless actions.
16. Use `aria-live` sparingly and only for state that requires announcement.
17. Keep focus stable when async content refreshes.
18. Return focus to the opener after dismissing dialogs and drawers.
19. Preserve deep links when progressive sections are navigable destinations.
20. Keep search/filter state URL-addressable where users benefit from sharing or returning.
21. Normalize API error shapes at gateways rather than branching on raw transport responses in views.
22. Bound retries and cancellation explicitly.
23. Use `AbortController` for replaceable network work where current APIs permit it.
24. Avoid hidden singleton state in new modules.
25. Keep event names domain-specific and documented.
26. Ensure service-worker caching never stores mutation responses or sensitive endpoints.
27. Version cache strategy deliberately and document invalidation.
28. Audit all rewritten source files for leading spaces, one-line logic, and undocumented functions.
29. Read back every written file before testing so textual mistakes are caught before runtime noise.
30. Verify there are no new horizontal scrollbars at 320px, 375px, 768px, and a wide desktop size.
31. Verify interactive hit targets do not overlap at pinch-zoom/reflow conditions.
32. Verify no fixed element blocks native browser controls or safe areas.
33. Treat console warnings introduced by the migration as failures unless proven harmless and documented.
34. Keep migration adapters temporary and recorded in REMAINING_WORK.
35. Do not call the platform complete while production routes remain on unscoped legacy style contracts.

## Final architectural judgment

Build small, scoped primitives; migrate real production surfaces in evidence-backed waves; keep existing specialized local systems where they are already healthy; rewrite malformed dense source completely when touched; and close each wave with browser and static verification.
